Lavora con Lingua Bridge sul sito «%1$s»:
Work with Lingua Bridge on the site “%1$s” (%2$s): translate the content as drafts.
1. Download the connector (Node 18 or later, no dependencies) and check its SHA-256 fingerprint:
   curl -fsSL '%3$s' -o lingua-bridge-connector.mjs
   sha256sum lingua-bridge-connector.mjs   (on macOS: shasum -a 256 …)
   it must be %4$s
2. Start it in a separate terminal and leave it open (the secret goes in the environment variable, not as an argument):
   LINGUA_BRIDGE_PAIR='%6$s' node lingua-bridge-connector.mjs serve%5$s
   (Windows PowerShell: $env:LINGUA_BRIDGE_PAIR='%6$s'; node lingua-bridge-connector.mjs serve%5$s)
3. Read the guide and the manual: node lingua-bridge-connector.mjs help, then manual and brief.
